per_layer_decision_rationale.material_packet: Material remains material_extracted_with_gaps because no supplementary assets exist locally; this is kept separate from source-reviewed final acceptance.
per_layer_decision_rationale.validator_contract: The structural contract was already present; acceptance is based on source-reviewed owner-layer repair and strict gate reruns, not validator success alone.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: DBAASP assay/experiment/literature rows are source_verified where they match Table 3, Results Sections 3.5/3.6, and article metadata; APD6 AP05672 remains source_conflict for database-computed details not fully supported by primary rows.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Worker-2 rebuilt 20 source-supported records covering Table 3 MIC values, cancer-cell IC50 values, HDF toxicity, and HC50 hemolysis with units, targets, conditions, and locators.

per_layer_decision_rationale.publication_grade_review: The previous blocking ticket is closed because gate-changing local values were recovered; remaining limitations are explicit cautions rather than open rework.

caution_findings.evidence_context: Supplementary indexes and OA package inventory show no separate supplementary tables/files; all recoverable gate-changing values came from XML/PDF text and figures.
The paper names bacterial species and source laboratory but not per-species strain identifiers; target strain fields preserve this missingness.
APD6 AP05672 includes database-computed sequence-analysis/molecular-weight text that is not fully primary-source-supported and differs from Table 1 molecular weight, so it remains source_conflict.
Cyp1a1 CAFLUX reduction is source-supported; upstream AhR/membrane/apoptosis mechanisms remain hypotheses/context.
